name: Underage Drinking
overview: Scripture warns against the dangers of excessive drinking, highlighting that wine and strong drink can deceive and lead to unwise behavior, as seen in Proverbs 20:1. Believers are cautioned not to associate with those who indulge in drunkenness and reckless living (Proverbs 23:20), since such habits bring sorrow, contention, and physical harm (Proverbs 23:29). Even leaders are advised to abstain from strong drink to maintain wisdom and clear judgment (Proverbs 31:4). The warnings extend to the persistent pursuit of alcohol from morning to night, which leads to ruin (Isaiah 5:11), and believers are urged to be vigilant so that drunkenness does not overwhelm them and cause spiritual unpreparedness (Luke 21:34). Together, these verses underscore the importance of self-control and sobriety, especially for the young, to honor God and avoid the pitfalls of underage drinking.
